title: Backflow inspection cost: compare the complete visit scope
description: An inspection quote is only comparable when it identifies the asset, visit purpose, access conditions, certified-test status, report filing, repair.
prompt: What is included in the inspection price and what is explicitly excluded?
answer: An inspection quote is only comparable when it identifies the asset, visit purpose, access conditions, certified-test status, report filing, repair authorization, and exclusions. A low entry price can omit the actual completion work.
urgency: Escalate commercial access constraints, multiple assets, a compliance deadline, or ambiguous deliverables.
identifiers: Condition inspection and certified test are different work products.
Filing and repair authorization may be outside the base visit.
Exact asset identity makes quote comparisons meaningful.
